what_happened: After handoff the ego braked hard for no reason on an open highway, from 15.7 m/s down to 6.6 m/s, with no lead within about 43–59 m. It also drifted slightly left, and it fell about 20 m behind where the recorded car was. Actor 8, a replayed car following behind in the same lane, ran into it at 8.1 s. The overlap was scored as a front, at-fault collision, but the event is really a rear-end caused by phantom braking.
